patterns.name: UUID instead of branded ID
patterns.description: Entity creation uses crypto.randomUUID() instead of generating branded IDs matching the type system (F###, P###, S###)
patterns.root_cause: Repositories use generic UUID generation without awareness of branded type conventions
patterns.prevention: Implement sequential ID generation in base repository or ID service
patterns.detection: Check create handlers for crypto.randomUUID() vs branded format
patterns.fix_pattern: Query max(id), parse numeric suffix, increment, format with prefix

patterns.name: State machine duplication
patterns.description: VALID_TRANSITIONS constant duplicated across server and client code (4 locations)
patterns.root_cause: No shared package exports state machine logic, each module defines its own
patterns.prevention: Define state machines in @nomos-ai/types and import everywhere
patterns.fix_pattern: Extract to shared package, export as const, import in consumers

patterns.name: DB schema / Zod schema drift
patterns.description: Drizzle table schema missing columns that exist in the corresponding Zod type schema (e.g., project.status)
patterns.root_cause: Zod schemas and Drizzle schemas evolved independently without cross-validation
patterns.prevention: Add build-time check comparing Zod schema keys against Drizzle column names
patterns.detection: Compare exported Zod schema shape with Drizzle table columns
patterns.fix_pattern: Add missing columns + migration, or remove from Zod schema if not needed

patterns.name: TOCTOU in bulk operations
patterns.description: Bulk status update validates then modifies in separate steps without transaction
patterns.root_cause: Validation and mutation not wrapped in same transaction
patterns.prevention: Always use transactions for validate-then-mutate patterns
patterns.detection: Look for await Promise.all() followed by separate update calls

patterns.name: Error handling boilerplate duplication
patterns.description: Identical try-catch error handling pattern repeated 15+ times across all oRPC router handlers
patterns.root_cause: No shared error handling middleware or utility
patterns.prevention: Create withErrorHandling wrapper or oRPC middleware
patterns.fix_pattern: Extract to shared utility function in packages/api/src/utils/

patterns.name: Missing ownership/access control (IDOR)
patterns.description: Entity tables have no userId column — any authenticated user can CRUD any entity
patterns.prevention: Always include userId column with FK to auth.user table in entity schemas
patterns.detection: Check entity tables for userId/ownerId columns
patterns.fix_pattern: Add userId column, update repository methods to filter by userId, pass from auth context

patterns.name: Missing security headers
patterns.description: Hono server missing X-Frame-Options, CSP, HSTS, X-Content-Type-Options headers
patterns.root_cause: Security middleware not configured in server setup
patterns.prevention: Add secureHeaders middleware to all Hono servers
patterns.detection: Check server index.ts for secureHeaders or equivalent middleware

patterns.name: Feature status mismatch (phantom in_progress)
patterns.description: Features marked as in_progress in features.json but zero implementation code exists
patterns.root_cause: Status was updated prematurely before implementation started
patterns.prevention: Only transition to in_progress after initial code is committed
patterns.detection: Cross-reference feature status with git log/file existence
patterns.fix_pattern: Reset status to pending if no implementation files exist

patterns.name: Hardcoded frontend constants
patterns.description: CATEGORIES, PHASES, SIZES, statusColors defined inline in components instead of imported from types
patterns.root_cause: Components developed independently without centralizing shared constants
patterns.prevention: Export all enum values and display metadata from @nomos-ai/types
patterns.detection: Search for inline const arrays matching type enum values
patterns.fix_pattern: Export from types, import in all consuming components
